# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Market risk stays elevated (70) and prices climb (84), so lock‑in pricing where advised and press for volume discounts this week.  

## What changed  
- Overall market supply risk holds at 70.4 (no change) while price trend nudges up to 84.3 (+0.2) [1][2].  
- All five segments show “Rising” supply risk scores above 63, with price trends 80‑85, confirming a broad tightening [3].  
- Drivers: Semiconductor PPI +9.1% annualized, global chip sales +146 % YoY, TSMC revenue +50.9 % YoY, and Korea exports +171 % YoY all push tighter supply and higher prices [1‑4].  

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1  
- Lead time 14 weeks, channel stock 27,211 units (≈17.7 weeks of supply).  
- Price $5.56 for qty 1, $2.51 for 1 k units.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal order cadence.  


## Segment board  
- Processors & advanced logic – Supply 69.5 (Rising, 0), Price 80.0 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Supply 71.2 (Elevated, 0), Price 84.8 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Analog & power – Supply 65.5 (Rising, 0), Price 83.2 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers – Supply 68.9 (Rising, 0), Price 83.6 (Rising), High confidence.  
- Power discretes – Supply 63.9 (Rising, 0), Price 82.3 (Rising), Medium confidence.  

## Your BOM watchlist  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 82.7 % (Elevated).  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 82.7 % (Elevated).  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 82.6 % (Elevated).  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 82.2 % (Elevated), price 1 717 % above target.  
- **MT40A1G16TB-062E:F** – 52‑week lead time, supply risk 82.2 % (Elevated), price 4 556 % above target.  

## Outlook  
- Chip prices have a 66 % chance to rise in the next 3 months (expected +2.17 %, 80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %) – model‑tested edge.  
- In 6 months, price rise probability drops to 52 % (expected +4.34 %, 80 % range ‑8.79 % to +17.46 %) – trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization likely tightens 62 % in 3 months (expected +1.82 pts) and 60 % in 6 months (expected +3.64 pts) – baseline forecasts.  
- Buy‑timing: lock pricing for parts on the “Lock pricing” list (including IPB017N10N5ATMA1) and buy ahead for the “Buy ahead / lock pricing” list.  

## Negotiation angle  
- Push suppliers for volume‑based discounts on high‑risk, 52‑week lead‑time items (LCMXO2, XC7A35T, IS25LP128).  
- Request price‑lock agreements for parts flagged “Lock pricing” to hedge the 65 % upside price risk.  
- Emphasize the strong demand signals (PPI +9 %, sales +146 %) to justify tighter payment terms or early‑ship incentives.
